title: Financial Assistance for Parents Whose Infants are Enrolled in ECDA's Childminding Pilot Programme
what_it_is: Financial Assistance for Parents Whose Infants are Enrolled in ECDA's Childminding Pilot Programme

sections.label: Childminding Pilot subsidies and costs
sections.summary: Government subsidies and CDA funds make Childminding Pilot infant services cost parents around $700 monthly, below usual $1,200 to $2,800 rates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Besides the use of the Child Development Account (CDA) funds, the Government provides subsidies to ensure childminding services under the Early Childhood Development Agency's (ECDA's) Childminding Pilot for Infants are affordable.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For parents who use these services full-time, for five days a week for four weeks, they will pay around $700 a month in out-of-pocket expenses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: This is lower than the usual cost of childminding services today, which can be around $1,200 to $2,800 a month.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Of all families enrolled, more than 80% have used their infant's CDA monies to defray the out-of-pocket expenses of childminding services under this pilot.

sections.label: Childminding Pilot scope and subsidies
sections.summary: The Childminding Pilot runs at two centres for up to 100 infants, with supply-side subsidies and CDA monies, while low-income families get more support in government preschools.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: I wish to highlight and inform the Member that the Childminding Pilot is actually a pilot.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: We only offer it at two centres currently and taking care of no more than 100 infants at this current juncture.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: The objective of the pilot really is for us to explore how to do this well and to scale this across the country, including how to make it even more inclusive for all children, for all income types as well as to understand what operators need to do to keep this a viable model.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Therefore, currently, we only provide supply-side subsidies to the operators as well as on the CDA monies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Our low-income families when they enrol in our Government-supported preschools, they will, as the Member is aware, receive a lot more subsidy options, including means-tested subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: With fee caps in our Government preschools, after preschool subsidies, our lower-income families can actually pay as low as $40 for full-day infant care in Anchor Operator preschools.
